answer: Fifteen years on one number. Phone number tenure asks the carrier, not the claimant: one number active since 2011. The carrier holds the history - calls, bills, contacts - so the trellis of the idea is that record, kept by a stranger with no reason to lie. A farm needs a hundred such numbers, and the pulse in each is the billing trail spanning a decade and naming a real person. The mirror that seals it is the first call: placed in 2011, logged forever, impossible to backdate.
